explanation.headline: Docetaxel is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC discontinued its product on 2026-02-20

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows docetaxel is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC discontinued its docetaxel injection with an initial posting date of 2026-02-20 and an update date of 2026-02-20, citing a business decision to discontinue manufacture.
Corvale East holds 52 vials of docetaxel 160 mg/8 mL at 2.5 vials per day, providing 21 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 81 vials of docetaxel 160 mg/8 mL at 2.9 vials per day, providing 27.9 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from Accord Healthcare Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
The second option is to buy from Actavis Pharma, Inc., also not on FDA's shortage list today with no plant placement on its label.
The third option is to buy from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., likewise not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
